name: Carrion Defense Works AMR-3 'Gravedigger'
description:
A bolt-action anti-materiel rifle chambered in 12.7mm with a uniquely long 1,200mm barrel designed for extreme-range precision — the Gravedigger sacrifices rate of fire and portability for accuracy that borders on surgical at distances exceeding 2,500 meters. The weapon uses a free-floating barrel with harmonic dampening, a precision-machined bolt with zero vertical play, and match-grade ammunition hand-loaded to individual weapon specifications. Each Gravedigger is test-fired at the factory and ships with a ballistic profile unique to that specific weapon.

Carrion designed the AMR-3 as a precision anti-materiel tool for engagements where the first shot must hit because there will be no second shot. At 2,500 meters, the round's flight time exceeds 3 seconds — long enough for any aware target to move, any vehicle to reposition, any alert to be sounded. The Gravedigger operator gets one chance, and the weapon is built to ensure that chance is not wasted.

The Gravedigger's extreme range creates a unique tactical problem for defenders: at 2,500 meters, the shooter is beyond the effective range of almost every weapon system that isn't itself an anti-materiel rifle. Locating the firing position requires specialized counter-sniper assets, and by the time those assets deploy, the Gravedigger operator has disassembled the weapon and vanished. The weapon breaks down into three sections that fit in a standard duffel bag, and an experienced operator can transition from firing to packed in under 90 seconds.
legality: Military only — prohibited for any non-military use
specifications:
caliber: 12.7x108mm match
action: Bolt-action
magazine: 3 rounds
effective range: 2,500+ meters
muzzle velocity: 900 m/s
barrel length: 1,200mm
weight: 16 kg
length: 1,900mm (assembled)
disassembly time: 90 seconds to field-packed
tactical_use: Extreme-range precision anti-materiel and anti-personnel engagement. Each shot is a deliberate action preceded by extensive calculation of windage, elevation, temperature, humidity, and Coriolis effect. The Gravedigger is deployed when the target must be destroyed from a distance that makes attribution functionally impossible.
cultural_context: The Gravedigger is a ghost weapon — used from distances where the shooter is invisible, inaudible, and effectively immune to retaliation. In GLMZ's threat landscape, the Gravedigger represents the ultimate expression of asymmetric violence: one person, one weapon, one shot, from a position so far away that the target never knew they were in danger.
known_users: Exactly one known freelance operator — callsign 'Sexton'
story_hooks: A target was killed at an officially measured distance of 2,847 meters — a shot that required the round to travel for over 4 seconds through urban wind corridors. The ballistic profile matches a Gravedigger, but no known operator has the skill for that shot. Someone new is working.

Three Gravedigger rifles have been stolen from a military armory. Each weapon's unique ballistic profile is on file, meaning any round fired can be traced to the specific weapon. But the thief also stole the ballistic records, and without them, the weapons are ghosts.

physical_description.visual_profile: A skeletal, purpose-built precision instrument that screams extreme-range lethality. The AMR-3's defining characteristic is its exceptionally long, pencil-thin barrel that dominates the entire weapon profile — it's all business, stripped of everything unnecessary. The stock is minimalist and angular, the action utterly exposed, giving it the appearance of a surgical tool rather than a firearm. There's something almost predatory about its proportions: a weapon designed to kill from beyond the horizon.
physical_description.dimensions: 1,900mm assembled length; 1,200mm barrel; compact when broken into three field-packed sections (each ~650mm when disassembled)
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial at 16kg, but distributed along the barrel for balance. Feels heavy enough to demand respect, yet not unwieldy when properly supported — a precision instrument that requires commitment, not a spray weapon
physical_description.primary_material: Chromium-molybdenum steel barrel with aerospace-grade aluminum receiver and titanium action components. Composite stock of carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer with steel reinforcement points
physical_description.finish: Matte black Cerakote coating on steel surfaces with a gunmetal gray anodize on aluminum. The barrel has a distinctive honed, almost brushed appearance — evidence of precision machining and harmonic tuning marks visible under close inspection
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary matte black with gunmetal gray accents. Minimal visual noise — pure functional aesthetics. Bare titanium action bolts visible as small silver points
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured composite grip with micro-pattern texture for secure holding in field conditions. Bare aluminum furniture with subtle knurling for positive control. Cool to the touch, industrial feel
distinctive_features: Extraordinarily long, precision-honed barrel with visible machine marks indicating harmonic dampening treatment
Exposed precision bolt with zero-play engineering visible on the receiver face
Three-point rapid-disassembly system with flush quick-release pins color-coded (red/blue/yellow)
Integral Picatinny rails on receiver and barrel for optics and ballistic computers
Ammunition storage cavity in stock base containing weapon-specific ballistic profile cards (laminated, wear-resistant)
Serial number and factory test-fire data engraved on receiver with microscopic precision
Heat vents along receiver to manage thermal signature from sustained use
Minimal muzzle device — just a small precision crown with no flash hider (designed for 2,500m+ where muzzle flash is irrelevant)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS stamped on receiver in small, utilitarian sans-serif font. Weapon-specific serial number and factory test-fire coordinates laser-etched on aluminum rail. Caliber marking (12.7x108mm MATCH) beneath the chamber. Tier-5 military-only classification stamp on the stock (small red triangle with Greek phi symbol Φ inside)
physical_description.condition_typical: Factory-fresh condition when deployed (the Gravedigger is too specialized for field maintenance). Shows minimal wear due to low round count. May display light surface marks from storage and transport, but the precision surfaces remain pristine. This is a weapon that gets broken down and stored immediately after use
